polynomial_order.description: Remove polynomial trend of order 'm' (default is m=1; m=-1 means no detrending).
polynomial_order.title: Polynomial order

autoclip.description: Clip off low-intensity regions in the dataset.
autoclip.title: Autoclip flag

automask.description: Use automask to clip low-intensity regions.
automask.title: Automask flag

prefix.description: Prefix for the output dataset (default is 'MSE').
prefix.title: Output prefix

scales.description: The number of scales to be used in the calculation (default is 5).
scales.title: Number of scales

entwin.description: The window size used in the calculation (default is 2).
entwin.title: Window size

rthresh.description: The radius threshold for determining if values are the same in the SampleEn calculation, in fractions of the standard deviation (default is 0.5).
rthresh.title: Radius threshold
